title: Rubric Semantics or Numerical Priors? Auditing Scale-Direction Bias in LLM Judges
abstract: arXiv:2611.25588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent benchmark evaluations increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) as automatic judges. This paradigm assumes LLMs evaluate based on the rubric's semantic meaning rather than its numeric scale. We question this assumption by introducing semantic faithfulness: the principle that semantically equivalent rubrics must yield consistent scores. To quantify this, we propose a scale-reversal probe that inverts score anchors without altering evaluation criteria. Furthermore, we introduce floor normalization to calibrate reversal disagreement against intrinsic model variability, enabling fair cross-model comparisons. Experiments across five meta-evaluation benchmarks with seven diverse LLM judges spanning open-weight and proprietary models reveal widespread violations of semantic faithfulness, showing that raw reversal agreement alone is misleading. translated_title: 量规语义还是数值先验？审计大语言模型评审中的量表方向偏差
translated_abstract: 近期的基准评估越来越依赖大语言模型（LLMs）作为自动评审。这一范式假设LLM是基于量规的语义含义而非其数值量表进行评估的。我们通过引入“语义忠实性”原则来质疑这一假设：语义等价的量规必须产生一致的评分。为了量化这一点，我们提出了一种量表反转探针，它在不改变评估标准的情况下反转评分锚点。此外，我们引入了地板归一化方法，将反转分歧相对于模型固有变异性进行校准，从而实现公平的跨模型比较。在涵盖开源权重和专有模型的七个多样化LLM评审者的五个元评估基准上进行的实验揭示了语义忠实性的普遍违背，表明仅凭原始反转一致性具有误导性。最后，我们证明了双向锚点平均能够降低对任一单一量表方向的依赖。
tldr: 该论文提出“语义忠实性”概念以及量表反转探针和地板归一化方法，揭示了大语言模型自动评审普遍存在量表方向偏差——评分依赖数值锚点而非量规语义，并证明双向锚点平均可有效缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces semantic faithfulness, a scale-reversal probe, and floor normalization to reveal pervasive scale-direction bias in LLM judges—whose scores depend on numerical anchors rather than rubric semantics—and demonstrates that bidirectional anchor averaging mitigates this bias.
